title: Updating the Current-Code Register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $8$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by setting its current-code field to $y$.
replaced:
Let a register record have its 15 natural-number coordinates stored in order as a
vector, with coordinate 8 equal to its current-code field. Replacing coordinate 8 of
this vector by a natural number $y$ gives the vector of the record obtained by replacing
its current-code field by $y$.
